item.title: GTA 6 Caused a Mass 'Migration' of Over 2 Million People
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 was released on Thursday, Nov. 19... officially. Millions of players around the world actually got to play it on Nov. 18 by moving to New Zealand. Well, not actually. Players just changed their account's region to New Zealand. It's a known trick that lets gamers access digital games before release when companies opt for a staggered launch, as with GTA 6 . Reports indicate that, in the UK and the US, 2 million Xbox players used the New Zealand trick to gain access to GTA 6 early. And that doesn't even account for the rest of the world or PlayStation players.

item.title: AI could open wallets where ERP upgrade pitches can't, says PwC
item.description: Global consultancy PwC says IT departments struggling to secure funding for ERP upgrades should make the expected benefits of AI part of their pitch. The Oracle and SAP mega-partner told El Reg that a "clean core" – modern enterprise applications with fewer customizations embedded in the underlying system – makes deploying AI agents easier. Selling that prospect, rather than incremental improvements to existing processes, could help IT leaders justify a migration. Oracle and SAP are both trying to persuade customers to move from established ERP systems to newer platforms. For SAP, that means S/4HANA, preferably in the cloud. For Oracle, it means Fusion Cloud Applications. Moving from ECC or E-Business Suite, respectively, can involve root-and-branch changes to technology and business processes, rather than a straightforward software upgrade. Thousands of organizations still rely on these aging, often heavily customized systems. IT leaders struggle to justify a costly, time-consuming migration when the reward appears to be doing the same meat-and-veg business processes slightly better. For example, a survey of SAP users last year found that 95 percent said building a positive case for migration required substantial effort or was genuinely challenging. Speaking to The Register , Jennifer Colapietro, PwC digital core modernization platform leader, said: "You're seeing it a lot more as part of the rationale for the business case for why they should upgrade, answering the question: 'Why now? What should we prioritize?' Certainly, AI and getting the value of AI, a key business case justification for that. "Folks have budgets for ERP, but now [funding for transformation is] being split because they also have budgets for AI. But there's synergies across them. If you look at moving to a clean digital core ERP, that will help them to realize the AI value faster... be able to turn on AI and be able to start to automate a lot of the processes and implement the agents. That helps to build the business case." SAP recently introduced Joule 2.0 while Oracle has announced Fusion Claw . With both of these new technologies, the vendors are promising customers they can build AI agents to automate business processes and perform some work that was previously done by humans. Colapietro argued that moving to more modern platforms makes deploying AI agents easier and more effective than adding AI capabilities around legacy systems. "It is more challenging to apply AI to the older systems. We focus on the importance of a clean digital core as the foundation for getting the value and effectiveness out of AI and scaling AI responsibly. I think that's given," she said. An ERP replacement isn't the only route to AI, however. European home improvement retailer Kingfisher – which owns the B&Q brand in the UK – eschewed SAP's overtures to upgrade its ECC system, despite encroaching deadlines. item.title: Two Spurs stars return to training ahead of Ipswich clash
item.description: Two Spurs stars return to training ahead of Ipswich clash Savio and Lucas Bergvall were both back in Tottenham training ahead of their match against Ipswich this weekend. The pair have both been ruled out with injury since the 1-1 draw against Manchester United last month . Savio with a muscular injury, and Bergvall with a knee injury. After Mathys Tel went off injured against Leeds after a strong tackle from Jayden Bogle, Savio’s reintroduction into the Spurs setup will be a massive boost for Roberto De Zerbi. The Italian hinted that the Brazilian could return after the international break before their draw against Leeds, saying, “Mudryk and Savio after the international break.” Mykhailo Mudryk, who has been sidelined since his debut against Nottingham Forest in September, and Tel were both not pictured in training. Asked after the Leeds clash about Tel’s injury, De Zerbi said, “Bad injury. Now we have to make the medical checks and in the next day we will know the problem.”

item.title: Max Verstappen: “I really thought that we would not win a race this year”
item.description: Motorsport photo Heading into the Las Vegas Grand Prix on a run of eight consecutive podiums, Max Verstappen looks every bit the force who dominated Formula 1 earlier this decade. Back in March, however, the four-time world champion was braced for his first winless campaign since 2015. Speaking during Las Vegas media day, Verstappen reflected on the scale of Red Bull Racing ’s mid-season recovery during Formula 1’s sweeping 2026 chassis and engine overhaul - the team’s first year running its in-house Red Bull Ford power unit. "Did I personally expect it to be like this after the first few rounds? For sure not," Verstappen said. "I really thought that we would not win a race this year and now we are constantly fighting for a win or close to it." Read Also: Fan voting opens for the Autosport Awards Across the first three rounds in Australia, China, and Japan, Verstappen managed just 12 points - finishing sixth in Melbourne, retiring in Shanghai, and crossing eighth at Suzuka - while publicly describing the RB22 as "completely undriveable" in China due to acute cornering balance issues. He went four races without a podium and endured 15 grands prix without P1, absorbing four retirements across China, Monaco, Great Britain, and the Netherlands. Fixing the car and learning the engine Asked whether Red Bull’s 2026 recovery mirrored its adjustments from a year earlier, Verstappen shut down the comparison immediately. "No, no, not related at all. Because we, this year, have very, very different problems to last year," he said. "So, it was a combination of putting more performance on the car, but at the same time also just fixing some of our problems, which automatically would give us more performance." That step-by-step progress extended beyond aerodynamics. "Also, engine side, we understood a lot more what we wanted from the engine," Verstappen noted. "Still, there’s always room for improvement; we know that. That’s what we are constantly working on." Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing The payoff arrived in autumn. Verstappen broke his P1 drought on 4 October in Malaysia, swept the sprint and grand prix in Singapore a week later, and added a third victory in Mexico City on 1 November. Coupled with second place in São Paulo, the surge lifted him to second in the drivers’ championship on 279 points - 111 behind newly crowned champion Kimi Antonelli, yet 17 clear of George Russell - while keeping Red Bull third in the constructors’ fight. "Hats off to the whole team; they’ve done a really good job," Verstappen said. "But now, we also look forward, and yeah, still look into some of the weaknesses that we have and things that we want to change for next year to hopefully make the car even better." To read more Motorsport.com articles visit our website .

item.title: Tonda Eckert signs Southampton contract extension after ‘Spygate’ scandal
item.description: Tonda Eckert has signed a contract extension at Southampton after surviving the storm of the ‘Spygate’ scandal. Eckert found himself under immense scrutiny after Southampton were caught spying on their Championship play-off semi-final opponents Middlesbrough last season. An investigation found Saints had also spied on two other teams that seasons and the club were subsequently kicked out of the Championship play-off final and docked four points at the start of the season season, admitting to three breaches of EFL regulations. Eckert accepted responsibility and was given a six-week suspended ban, with Southampton opting to stand by their manager amid the controversy. But despite the points deduction, Southampton sit five points off the top of the table after a stellar start to the season. Eckert said: "We've had some conversations that started a couple of weeks ago, and the goal was always clear: to show the same commitment that we have had for the last 12 months. I'm very happy that we have come to the point that we can make it official now. "There is a lot that has happened in the last 12 months, but the commitment from the club, from Dragan, Johannes and Phil, and the supporters, means everything to me. I am very grateful for that. We have started a journey that is not even halfway through - there is a lot more to come." More follows

item.title: OFFICIAL: Courtois signs Real Madrid contract extension
item.description: Real Madrid have announced the extension of Thibaut Courtois’ contract with the club until the summer of 2028. Per Realmadrid.com Real Madrid C.F. and Thibaut Courtois have agreed to extend our player’s contract, which ties him to the club until June 30, 2028. Thibaut Courtois joined Real Madrid in 2018. In his nine seasons wearing our jersey, he has played 348 matches and won 14 titles: 2 Champions League titles, 3 Club World Cups, 2 UEFA Super Cups, 3 La Liga titles, 1 Copa del Rey, and 3 Spanish Super Cups. His contribution to all these titles has been marked by decisive performances that have established him as the best goalkeeper in the world. He is an international with Belgium, having played 115 matches for his national team so far. Individually, Thibaut Courtois has won the Golden Glove at the 2018 World Cup in Russia, The Best FIFA Goalkeeper Award in 2018, the Yashin Trophy in 2022, and the Zamora Trophy in 2014. Additionally, he was included twice in the FIFA FIFPro World XI in 2022 and 2023 and was named the Best Player of the Champions League Final in Paris 2022, Real Madrid’s Fourteenth European Cup victory. Courtois is 34 years old but is arguably the world’s best goalkeeper, so this one-year extension makes sense.

item.title: Liverpool boss Taylor impressed with goalscoring form of forward Olsson
item.description: Liverpool boss Taylor impressed with goalscoring form of forward Olsson Liverpool head coach Gareth Taylor says that forward Beata Olsson’s recent goalscoring form has been impressive. The Swedish international has netted six goals in the last four games. She has helped Liverpool win three of those matches. Speaking to the media ahead of this weekend’s Barclays Women’s Super League fixture against Chelsea, Liverpool head coach Taylor said that Olsson’s run of form has been impressive whilst highlighting areas where she can improve further. “Beata will always tell you that there’s way more to come from her,” Taylor said. “She’s definitely a very hungry player, great to work with. She is very honest in her appraisal of herself in games and in training. Like most strikers, she is desperate to score in every game and is super-frustrated when she doesn’t. Of course, she contributes more than that for us as a player, but you know that Beata has these spells where she really catches fire. “For her, it will always be about how many chances she gets in a game, how many times she makes the goalkeeper work. The more she does that, the more chances she has of scoring. She is a good finisher, there is no doubt about that, but I think getting her in the right positions, getting players to connect with her more is really important for us as a team. “She’s been good. Six goals in four games is really impressive.” Latest opponents Chelsea arrive on Merseyside top of the Barclays Women’s Super League table, but Taylor believes that his side will go into the game with confidence. He said “It’s a good game. We’ve both had quick turnarounds with us playing Wednesday night and it’s an early kick-off as well. “Good for us to be at St Helens. We had success in this fixture last year by taking a draw, but both teams will look slightly different to what they did then. “We feel pretty confident that we can attack this game like we would any other game. Our performances against the top teams have been good and positive this season. Looking forward to the challenge.” Liverpool have won their last three games, scoring 11 goals in the process. Taylor says that The Reds had been impressive even before those positive results. He said “Small wins for us, of course; two wins in the cup and a good win away at Brighton. “We are good in confidence. I’ve spoken to the players a lot; even though our results before that were a little bit tricky, I was impressed with our performances and knew that we weren’t far away from what we have achieved in the last three games. We’ve managed to score 11 goals against decent opposition in those three games. “We know the challenge tomorrow is really tough. They have a good level of players and they’re a good team, so we need to be at our very best to have a chance of taking points from the game.” Liverpool’s Barclays Women’s Super League fixture against Chelsea takes place at BrewDog Stadium in St Helens at 12.45pm on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Bubba Wallace’s Team Makes Another Risky Decision
item.description: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images 23XI Racing is changing the leadership atop two of its teams for 2027, and Bubba Wallace will have a new voice directing his efforts from the pit box. The organization announced Nov. 18 that Davin Restivo will replace Charles Denike as crew chief of Wallace’s No. 23 Toyota. Denike will move to the No. 67 team to work with Corey Heim, who is preparing for his first full-time NASCAR Cup Series season. Tyler Reddick will retain Billy Scott as crew chief of the No. 45 team. The changes follow a productive season for 23XI. The organization recorded eight victories in 2026, including six by Reddick and two by Heim. Wallace did not reach Victory Lane, but he finished the year with 17 top-10 results, five top-five finishes and two runner-up performances. Wallace and Denike had previously enjoyed success together, including their victory in the 2025 Brickyard 400. Their partnership ends after two seasons, with 23XI choosing to take a different approach as it looks to build a championship contender. The team says the moves are about matching personnel strengths to each driver’s needs. Dave Rogers, 23XI’s senior director of competition, explained that Denike’s calm leadership style should benefit Heim as he makes the jump to a full-time Cup schedule. Rogers also pointed to Restivo’s relentless attitude and attention to detail as qualities that make him a good fit for Wallace. Denny Hamlin, 23XI’s co-owner, emphasized that the organization wants to build on its winning season rather than settle for its current results. “While this was a banner year for us in the win column, it has always been our goal to build a championship-caliber organization,” Hamlin said in the team’s announcement. For Wallace, the change brings another opportunity to turn consistent finishes into victories. Restivo spent the past two seasons leading Riley Herbst’s team at 23XI, so he already knows the organization and its expectations. The new pairing will have to prove itself on the track, but 23XI is making clear that its ambitions extend beyond simply adding to its win total. The goal is to put all three teams in a stronger position to compete for a Cup Series championship .

item.title: Confirmed: Real Madrid squad list to face Celta Vigo | La Liga MD 13
item.description: Confirmed: Real Madrid squad list to face Celta Vigo | La Liga MD 13 With the international break out of the way, Real Madrid are back in action on Sunday as they get set to lock horns with Celta Vigo at the Santiago Bernabeu on Matchday 13 of the 2026/27 La Liga. Having strung together an impressive run of eight wins prior to the break, Real Madrid will be eager to carry on from where they left off and secure all three points against Claudio Giraldez & co. tomorrow. Ahead of tomorrow’s match, Los Blancos manager Jose Mourinho has announced the squad list of players who will be at his disposal for selection. The biggest headline is that key superstar Vinicius Jr. is back in the squad for Real Madrid after having missed the last four games in La Liga due to a suspension for his red card against Villarreal. The 26-year-old attacker has missed the games against Sevilla, Barcelona, Racing Santander, and Valencia. Having scored five goals in two games for Brazil during the international break, he will hope to carry on in the same vein of form for his club. Aurelien Tchouameni and Bernardo Silva, who returned with minor injuries during the break, have been declared fit and are in the squad to face Celta Vigo. Meanwhile, Raul Asencio and Rodrygo remain unavailable as they continue to recover from their fitness issues. Ferland Mendy was expected to be recalled to the squad, having been training with the group for some time now, but Mourinho has opted not to include the veteran left-back.

item.title: Foxes announce new sponsor after porn actress row
item.description: BC Game has been the main shirt sponsor of Leicester City for two and a half years [Getty Images] Leicester City have announced a new main shirt sponsor after ending a partnership with a gambling firm following its appointment of a porn actress as its brand ambassador. The League One side confirmed they have now partnered with Bossjob, an AI-powered recruitment and job-matching platform based in Singapore. On Wednesday, the club announced its split with BC Game - which was named as a sponsor for the Foxes at the start of the 2024-25 season. The club's commercial director, Russell Jones, said the new men's team sponsor would be in place for the remainder of the 2026-27 season. The Foxes parted ways with BC Game, an online gambling company not available to UK users, after it named porn actress Eva Elfie as a brand ambassador earlier this month. Announcing the partnership , the firm posted a video of Elfie and a delivery driver on social media, with the caption: "Welcome to BC Game Eva Elfie! Let the fun begin." In response, fan group The Foxes Trust said: "Both gambling and pornography can have devastating impacts on people's lives, in particular young people. "Partnerships like these bring these two worlds to a larger audience and, by association, link them to Leicester City. Is this who we are now?" On Wednesday, following the criticism, the club issued a statement, which said it and BC Game had "reached a mutual agreement to conclude our commercial partnership with immediate effect". In a further statement on Friday, the Foxes confirmed Bossjob will take up the front-of-shirt position from this Saturday at their League One match against Huddersfield Town. Jones said: "We welcome Bossjob as our new principal partner for the remainder of the season and look forward to building a strong relationship over the coming months. "Through the partnership, we look forward to introducing Bossjob to our supporters and wider audiences, while supporting the company's ambitions to develop its international profile." The club said replica shirts featuring the new sponsor would be made available to fans "in the coming days". Bossjob co-founder, Quak Kiat How, added: "We're pleased to begin this partnership with Leicester City, a football club with a proud history and a strong connection to its supporters and local community. "We look forward to working with Leicester City throughout the remainder of the season." Listen to BBC Radio Leicester on Sounds and follow BBC Leicester on Facebook , on X , or on Instagram . item.title: Andriy Shevchenko slams Mykhailo Mudryk for ‘baseless slander’ after Ukraine doping claim
item.description: Ukrainian football federation president Andriy Shevchenko has issued a sharp rebuke to Mykhailo Mudryk after the Chelsea winger blamed the national team for his positive drugs test. Mudryk tested positive for the banned substance meldonium in 2024 , and was initially banned for four years by the Football Association . He successfully appealed against the length of his ban to the Court of Arbitration for Sport , and returned to football in July 2026. Speaking in an interview with Ukrainian YouTube channel Guest of Gordon, Mudryk, who is on a season-long loan at Tottenham, laid the blame on “the environment in the Ukrainian national team” for his suspension. He said: “I had never heard of a drug like meldonium . It is a drug you can only get in Eastern Europe. It could only have got into my body in Ukraine. There is no such drug in England.” He said he had only been in Ukraine with the national team, which “points to the fact it was in a national team camp”. Former Chelsea and AC Milan forward Shevchenko, now president of the Ukrainian Association of Football (UAF), called such claims “baseless slander” and said that “numerous investigations and audits” had been unable to identify how or when the meldonium entered Mudryk’s system. He alleged that Mudryk’s camp had tried to convince a staff member at the UAF to take the blame for the 25-year-old’s positive test. Shevchenko said: “His representatives repeatedly approached the UAF with a proposal to find an employee who would falsely take responsibility for the meldonium found in his doping sample. “The UAF refused, as such a proposal contradicts the principles of our work.” Shevchenko criticised his compatriot for “baseless slander against our people, who do their work honestly and professionally”, and challenged Mudryk to provide evidence for his claims, including that he had received little support from the federation during the doping case. He added: “I know the people who have worked with the national team for many years. I trust them, because throughout all this time there have been no incidents in the team that could make anyone doubt their professionalism. “If Mykhailo has evidence to back up his words, let him provide it. If no such evidence exists, I expect him to publicly retract his accusations and apologise to the people whose honesty and professionalism he has called into question.”

item.title: Pre-Feast week SoCon power rankings
item.description: Nov 3, 2025; Knoxville, Tennessee, USA; Mercer Bears guard Quinton Perkins II (3) brings the ball up court against the Tennessee Volunteers during the second half at Thompson-Boling Arena at Food City Center. Mandatory Credit: Randy Sartin-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Now a full two weeks into the college basketball season, I’ve had a chance to see everyone in the SoCon play so far, and this is my first edition of my power rankings for the 2026-27 season. I have teams lower in this first release than I think they will finish, which is primarily based on the fact that I have either only seen them once, or I rewarded teams for getting a Division-I win or wins rather than loading up on non-Division I wins so far, so don’t crucify me yet. It’s been an exciting first couple of weeks, and Tennessee Tech might be the favorite team I have watched so far based on style of play. I thoroughly enjoyed being able to watch the Golden Eagles take down a good Western Kentucky team last Sunday. I am extremely impressed with CBO Newton and the Golden Eagles’ ability to shoot the three. The question will be for them is how they can defend. I hope y’all enjoy the pre-Feast Week SoCon power rankings. Our next release will be after Feast Week. I hope everyone has a Happy and Blessed Thanksgiving. 1. Furman (5-1) The Paladins have looked good in their first three games, mediocre in the road win at Holy Cross, while struggling to find any kind of offensive rhythm in the loss at Belmont last time out. The Paladins have seen Collin O’Neal join already injured Cole Bowser and Mason Smith on the list of early-season injuries, though Smith and Bowser are expected to return from their respective injuries sooner rather than later. Furman’s Cameron Elwer is starting to heat up, as he scored 13 points to lead the Paladins in the road loss at Belmont Saturday night. item.title: Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink: Middlesbrough have been flirting with PL promotion for years now, I hope they can finally do it this season
item.description: Football icon Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink has said that he wants his former club Middlesbrough to finally end a decade of exile from the Premier League this season. Boro narrowly missed out on automatic promotion last campaign after being consistently in the race before losing to a late Oli McBurnie goal in the play-off final. Kim Hellberg’s side currently sit second in the Championship table, level on points with leaders Birmingham. For exclusive stories and all the detailed EFL news you need, subscribe to The Football League Paper website, digital edition, or newspaper from as little as 14p a day. Special In an exclusive interview with 10bet , Hasselbaink expressed his desire to see Boro return to the top flight whilst acknowledging the tough competition the club faces in the Championship. Hasselbaink said “They’ve been flirting with promotion during the last three or four years. The problem that Boro have had is being able to sustain what they’ve built in the second half of the season. “I would love to see them get back up there, because Boro are a special club in a really special part of the world. “Football means everything to the people in that town, and they deserve a club in the Premier League. “Hopefully they can sustain that momentum. Let’s be honest though, as much as I would love to see them do it, it will be really, really difficult. “The Championship is such a difficult league to get out of – Boro has been trying for almost a decade. If they can climb out of there, it will be one hell of a job because you’ve got West Ham, Wolves and a few others who are top, top teams.” READ MORE: Five EFL talking points: Bradford City takeover? item.title: How ex-West Ham striker Dylan Tombides has left a legacy
item.description: It is 15 years since former West Ham United striker Dylan Tombides was diagnosed with cancer following his participation at the Fifa Under-17 World Cup, but his legacy is now helping educate the next generation at the latest edition of the tournament in Qatar. After the former Australia youth international died from the disease in 2014, Dylan's mother, Tracey Lee, and brother, Taylor Tombides, launched the DT38 Foundation. Now working in partnership with Fifa, they are raising awareness of testicular cancer, the most common cancer among males aged 15 to 44, through Dylan's story. He made one first-team appearance for West Ham before his death aged 20. "To be linked with Fifa is the top of the mountain, as far as we're concerned," Lee said. "It puts legitimacy to what we are doing and, as far as does it help us with the grief? Yes, it helps us because we know we're saving lives. "We've got messages from people saying: 'I thought of Dylan's story when I found a lump and I knew not to delay. I had testicular cancer and now I'm cancer-free and Dylan saved my life'. "That tells us that what we're doing is life-changing for that family, that person." Dylan Tombides displayed a happy birthday message to his mum after scoring in the 2011 Fifa Under-17 World Cup [Getty Images] Each participating team has received a presentation on recognising the signs of testicular cancer and the importance of self-examination. Some sessions initially prompted laughter and jokes among players when testicles were discussed in front of team-mates. However, Fifa medical director, Dr Andrew Massey, said the message had resonated across all 48 teams, featuring 1,200 players, as Lee shared the story of her son's diagnosis and treatment. "Dylan went to his GP," she said. "He decided he didn't want to go to the club doctors because they were in a relegation battle and he wanted them to focus on football in 2011. "So he went to the GP and he said, 'Don't worry, mate, it's just a cyst and people live with cysts all the time.' "So Dylan finished the season with West Ham, flew out to Australia to join his team-mates there and trained out there until they went to Mexico. "And it was out at Mexico that they pulled Dylan for a random drug test and it came back positive for a banned substance or a tumour. "And as it turned out, Dylan then finally got correctly diagnosed with testicular cancer, and then started with the removal of his testicle and three years of really intense chemotherapy." She added: "I remember sitting there having a conversation with Dylan and they were saying the next treatment has a 10% chance of working. And we know how that turned out. "It's that story that prompted young players from the Jamaican youth national team to say 'I am so sorry for your loss' with conversations with the French team ending in hugs and handshakes."

item.title: Nick Wright says one NFL player is sneakily having an MVP level season
item.description: Photo by Perry Knotts/Getty Images Nick Wright has floated the idea that Jaxon Smith-Njigba could be in contention for the 2026 NFL MVP award. The Seattle Seahawks as a team have declined this year, already losing four games after going 14-3 en route to the Super Bowl in the previous campaign. But while they have fallen off, Smith-Njigba is still one of the best receivers in the NFL in the current season. He has the most receiving yards (1,207) of any player by a considerable distance, with CeeDee Lamb (976) second. Jaxon is also leading the league in receiving touchdowns (10) and has the most receptions (79) ahead of the weekend’s action. In turn, it is perhaps not surprising that, when speaking via What’s Wright? With Nick Wright this week, Wright shared his opinion that Smith-Njigba could be a sneaky argument for MVP. He said: “The Lions can just hand the ball to Jahmyr Gibbs. That’s not how it works with JSN. And JSN has been doing it with two different quarterbacks, which I think is super impressive. I think JSN sneaky has an MVP argument, like Barnwell talked about. Everybody knows he’s the only way they can move the ball, and no one can slow him down.” History suggests Jaxon Smith-Njigba won’t be named MVP While the Seahawks wide receiver is no doubt in great form right now, the NFL has made a habit of only really giving the MVP award to quarterbacks. In fact, since 2012, running back Adrian Peterson is the only non-quarterback to pick up the prize: 2025 – Matthew Stafford (QB) 2024 – Josh Allen (QB) 2023 – Lamar Jackson (QB) 2022 – Patrick Mahomes (QB) 2021 – Aaron Rodgers (QB) 2020 – Aaron Rodgers (QB) 2019 – Lamar Jackson (QB) 2018 – Patrick Mahomes (QB) 2017 – Tom Brady (QB) 2016 – Matt Ryan (QB) 2015 – Cam Newton (QB) 2014 – Aaron Rodgers (QB) 2013 – Peyton Manning (QB) 2012 – Adrian Peterson (RB) Furthermore, a wide receiver has never actually been named the MVP during the history of the award. With that in mind, this year’s accolade will most likely end up in the hands of someone like Joe Burrow, Brock Purdy or Josh Allen. item.title: Jordan Reid Projects Dolphins To Skip Quarterback For Edge Rusher
item.description: Credit: Nathan Ray Seebeck-Imagn Images On Wednesday, Jordan Reid of ESPN published his initial 2027 mock draft, envisioning Texas edge rusher Colin Simmons being chosen by the Dolphins with the third overall pick. This choice comes despite the team holding a 1-8 record and likely owning that high slot. Reid argues Miami needs a defensive star more than another quarterback right now. The Dolphins have struggled to pressure opposing quarterbacks all season, recording just 13 sacks through nine games. That total stands as the fewest in the NFL. A Perfect Fit for Jeff Hafley The pairing of Simmons with existing talent creates a scary front for opposing offenses. Reid points out that the Dolphins already drafted Chop Robinson in the first round of 2024. Robinson has shown improvement after a tough 2025 season, but he needs help. “Pairing Simmons with 2024 first-rounder Chop Robinson would give the Dolphins an explosive pass-rush duo for defensive-minded coach Jeff Hafley.” This combination could finally give Miami’s defense a pass rusher that offenses have to fear.

item.title: Luis Enrique confirms key PSG attacker ready to play tomorrow after a month injured
item.description: Luis Enrique confirms key PSG attacker ready to play tomorrow after a month injured Ousmane Dembele is going to be fit to face Nice in Ligue 1 tomorrow after a month out of action, Luis Enrique has confirmed. If you enjoy PSG Talk coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. Ousmane Dembele hasn’t featured for PSG since the 20th October, when he hurt his thigh in the Champions League game against Barcelona. But after missing four games for his team, he’s been given the green light to return this weekend when PSG face Nice. Luis Enrique has just confirmed in his press conference that the attacker will be available. Dembele fit and happy to return against Nice Ousmane Dembele celebrates against Strasbourg. “The most important thing with Ousmane is to see if he’s smiling in training,” Enrique said in his presser just now. “If he wants to train and enjoy training, that’s the best way to know if he’s ready. From what I’ve seen this week, that’s the case. As a football supporter, it’s a real pleasure to see Ousmane Dembélé on the pitch.” Missing Dembele (and a number of other starters) has not slowed down PSG in the last month .They’re on a long winning run and other players have stepped up in the interim. But in a tricky game against Nice, everyone will be relieved to have the team’s talisman back in the attacking line. Lucho also confirmed that Desire Doue will be fit too. Maghnes Akliouche and Nuno Mendes have also been removed from the team’s medical report. In other news… Reporters claim that Lucas Chevalier has not asked to leave PSG in January, despite rumours to the contrary. Plans to hand Marquinhos a one year contract extension are already well underway, according to many sources.

item.title: ACC Roundup: A Perfect Wednesday
item.description: LAS VEGAS, NEVADA - NOVEMBER 19: Braeden Smith #3 of the Notre Dame Fighting Irish drives past Bukky Oboye #12 of the Auburn Tigers during the second half during the Fifth Place game in the Players Era 8 bracket of The 2026 Players Era Men's Championship at Michelob ULTRA Arena on November 19, 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada. (Photo by Zach Del Bello/Players Era/Getty Images) | Getty Images There were five ACC teams in action on Wednesday night, and all won: Louisville beat Stetson, 83-69, Notre Dame clawed Auburn 78-73, NC State raced past Murray State, 93-83, Stanford stung Sacramento State, 78-65, and Cal sent East Texas A&M home miserable, 86-54. Stetson started off hot, hitting 9 of their first 12 shots before Louisville woke up. Down 22-14, Flory Bidunga scored 7 straight points to rally the home team. Stetson held the lead until about the 5:31 mark, which is impressive. In the second half, Louisville cranked up the D, forcing Stetson to miss 18 of 20 attempts over about nine minutes. Incidentally, Karter Knox took Seth Trimble’s starting spot and finished with 14 points and 10 rebounds. Is it just us, or is it nice to see a bit of optimism for Notre Dame? The Irish are now 6-1, with the one loss to Florida. Against Auburn, the Irish started hot, going up 42-36 at the half, and shooting 50 percent. Auburn battled back in the second, but the Tigers missed six straight free throws late in the second half, then Braeden Smith hit a tough shot in the lane to put Notre Dame up by 77-73. Brady Koehler, who is getting some NBA buzz, stole Auburn’s inbounds pass, and hit a free throw to put the game out of reach. NC State was hot against Murray State, hitting 16-0f-28 threes for 57.1 percent. The defense was really good, too, holding the Racers to 2-12 in the first half, and limiting offensive threat Brayden Shorter to 2 points. The defense let up in the second half, as Murray State scored 57, but State controlled this game. Paul McNeil scored 33, and Preston Edmead had 20. On the downside, State coughed up 16 turnovers and lost the boards, 38-29. Sacramento State outplayed Stanford in the first half, 36-34, before the Cardinal figured it out in the second half. Stanford outscored Sacramento State 44-29 after the break, shooting 57.1 percent. A 10-0 run broke it open for the Cardinal. Julius Price had 22 points to pace Stanford. Christian Bliss had 16, while Nick Townsend kicked in 11. Cal broke the game open early, and never really was challenged. The Bears forced an impressive 24 turnovers, which they converted into 28 points. Nojus Indrusaitis had 23 points, while Michael Cooper added 18. item.title: Deshaun Watson Wants to Return, Continue to 'Build on the Legacy'
item.description: theOBR BEREA,Ohio — Ever since Cleveland Browns owner Jimmy Haslam proclaimed the trade for quarterback Deshaun Watson was a ‘big swing and miss’ at the NFL owners meetings in March of 2025, Browns fans had—for the most part—turned the page on the Watson era with the Browns. Even when Todd Monken was named the Browns newest head coach in January and he declared an open competition between Watson and second-year quarterback Shedeur Sanders, most assumed Watson was just going to be phased out being in the final year of his unprecedented contract that paid him $230 million, fully guaranteed. At the time of the trade in March 2022, it was the biggest contract in NFL history and first, fully guaranteed contract. The Browns also gave up six draft choices in the trade, including three first round picks. Before the 2026 season started, Watson had missed 49 of 68 games with the Browns due to an 11-game suspension from the NFL in 2022 and injuries in 2023-2025, including a broken bone in his throwing shoulder and a twice-ruptured Achilles tendon that sidelined him for all of 2025. However, Watson was tabbed by Monken after training camp as the starting quarterback after not playing in nearly two seasons and despite a rough start has stuck with him through 10 games. Even when Watson missed the Saints game after not practicing the week leading up to the game due to a concussion, Monken named Watson the starter for the Texans game, despite Sanders throwing for 297 yards in an overtime loss. Watson rewarded him with a come-from-behind, game-winning drive to give the Browns a 27-24 win and a 6-4 record at the bye. Watson, 31, has completed 65.1 percent of his passes for 2,118 yards. He is 11th in the NFL in completions, 16th in yardage, seven touchdowns (tied for 26th), four interceptions (tied for fourth-fewest). His 7.3 yards per attempt is 13th in the NFL and his 89.1 QB rating is 18th in the NFL. Watson has rushed 59 times for 266 yards and two touchdowns. The nine games that Watson has started in 2026 is the most he has played since joining the Browns. Despite being inconsistent, Watson has led the Browns to a 6-4 record, including six game-winning drives in the fourth quarter. Watson’s game-winning drive in the final two minutes last week against the Texans was his sixth of the season. He joined Troy Aikman in 1990 and Matthew Stafford in 2016 as the only quarterbacks to lead winning drives in the fourth quarter in each of their team’s first six victories. Watson is now tied with Bernie Kosar, who had six game-winning drives in the fourth-quarter in 1986. He is behind only Brian Sipe, who had seven in 1979 for most in a season in franchise history. On Wednesday of the bye week, Watson was asked if he would want to return to the Browns next season. “Yeah, of course I want to continue to build on the legacy that I’m building,” Watson said after practice. “And again, ultimately, it’s up to the front office. It’s up to Jimmy (Haslam) and Dee (Haslam). It’s up

item.title: “Imagine Claiming a Pitcher Waived by Mets” – Fans React to Cubs Acquiring 28-year-old DFA’d Pitcher
item.description: Chayce McDermott. Image via @iam_chaycemcdInstagram The Chicago Cubs have claimed 28-year-old right-handed pitcher Chayce McDermott off waivers from the New York Mets in the 2026-27 MLB offseason. No corresponding roster move was required, since Chicago already had open spots on its 40-man roster after protecting prospects ahead of the Rule 5 Draft. McDermott spent the 2026 season with the Baltimore Orioles, Los Angeles Dodgers and Mets. He posted a 5.87 ERA in 7.2 innings in five appearances. In his MLB career, he holds a 1-1 record and a 10.18 ERA across 10 appearances, including two starts. Fans shared their thoughts on the latest acquisition by the Cubs. “Imagine claiming a pitcher who was waived by the Mets. LOL,” one fan wrote. Several more fans came up with sarcastic remarks: These reactions make it clear that Cubs fans are not happy with this acquisition. Chicago fans expect major moves this offseason from the front office after being eliminated in the 2026 wild-card round during the postseason. The Cubs may have acquired McDermott due to his strikeout potential in the minor leagues. In six seasons, he has posted a 25-27 record with a 4.31 ERA, 625 strikeouts, and 278 walks in 445 innings pitched. McDermott is out of minor-league options, according to CubsHQ . That means Chicago cannot freely send him between the majors and minors without exposing him to waivers. Cubs Take Interest In Japanese Triple Crown Winner The Cubs need a couple of outfielders this offseason after Seiya Suzuki, Ian Happ, Michael Conforto, and Tyrone Taylor became free agents this winter. Currently, they have Pete Crow-Armstrong, Matt Shaw, Pedro Ramirez, and Kevin Alcantara in the outfield room. The Cubs have reportedly taken an interest in Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato to address their outfield depth, per Patrick Mooney of The Athletic . Sato was posted by the Hanshin Tigers on November 1. Therefore, he has until Dec. 16 to sign with an MLB team. The Japanese 6-foot-1 slugger hit .277/.345/.579 with 40 home runs, 34 doubles, four triples, 102 RBI, and 10 stolen bases in 139 games in 2025 to win the Central League MVP award. Last season, he won the NPB Central League Triple Crown after hitting .306/.383/.609 with 39 home runs, 40 doubles, three triples, 106 RBI, and eight stolen bases in 143 games. After the Cubs saw a lot of success with Japanese stars in Wrigley Field, with Seiya Suzuki and Shota Imanaga, it won’t be a surprise to see them make a play for Sato. item.title: C.J. Jones - an Ohio State, Alabama recruiting target - leads Westlake to UIL playoff win
item.description: Westlake running back C.J. Jones (43) scores a touchdown as Westlake and Pieper face off in a Class 6A Division II area round playoff game at Rattler Stadium in San Marcos on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026. Jones ran for 132 yards and five touchdowns, all in the first half of the game. (Mikala Compton/Austin American-Statesman) SAN MARCOS - C.J. Jones swears he doesn't have anything to do with it. Westlake's freshman phenom, who has college scholarship offers from just about any school you can think of, said the 132 yards and five touchdowns he ran for in the first half Thursday were a result of everyone else . Westlake quarterback Patton Jones (3) hands off the ball to Westlake wide receiver Chase Brodhead (16) as Westlake and Pieper face off in a Class 6A Division II area round playoff game at Rattler Stadium in San Marcos on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026. (Mikala Compton/Austin American-Statesman) "I don't really take any of the credit," said Jones, who is now 28 yards shy of 1,000 rushing for the season. "I have to give it all to the offensive line. They made the holes. I just ran the play like what the coach said, hit the hole and scored." It's an admirable trait for Jones to be modest with the spotlight that will be on him during his high school career. And while he did make several defenders miss once he got past the line of scrimmage, he is correct in that Westlake's offensive line was dominant during a 59-14 win over San Antonio Pieper in a Class 6A Division II area-round playoff game at Rattler Stadium. PHOTOS : See the best moments from Thursday's game MORE: Patton Jones takes over as Westlake's starting QB 'The front five and the coaches' The Chaps (11-1) ended with 279 yards rushing, a number that would have been far higher had they not maintained good field position thanks to their defense and special teams. "It's insane running behind those guys," Jones said. "They make the gaps and just make me feel safe out there." Jones scored on runs of 23, 11, 11, 34 and 3 yards as Westlake built a 38-0 halftime lead. He spent the entire second half on the sideline and probably could play as soon as Saturday if he needed to with as few hits as he took. Westlake's rushing attack didn't slow down without Jones, though. Chase Brodhead, Isaiah Mills and Pete Fredenburg all scored rushing TDs as the Chaps at one point led by 52. Westlake wide receiver Chase Brodhead (16) scores a touchdown as Westlake and Pieper face off in a Class 6A Division II area round playoff game at Rattler Stadium in San Marcos on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026. (Mikala Compton/Austin American-Statesman) "We kind of knew going in we could run the ball," Westlake coach Tony Salazar said. "They had some man-to-man coverage out there, and it's scary to take a shot on first down and then turn around and look at second-and-10 in the face, so in order to stay ahead of the chains, running the ball was essential." Jones should have at least two more games - Westlake will be a heavy favorite in the reg

item.description: Signal users on iOS will see this option to toggle blocking screenshots and preventing Siri AI from scanning on-screen content. | Image: Signal Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users' messages and other data. item.title: “Fire Him Tonight,” “Make Him Walk Back to Indy”: Colts Fans Call for Shane Steichen’s Exit After Humiliating 26–3 Loss to Texans
item.description: Shane Steichen, Jonathan Taylor. © Imagn Indianapolis Colts head coach Shane Steichen’s job security may be in question after the humiliating 26-3 defeat to the Houston Texans on Thursday Night Football. The loss dropped Indianapolis to 3-8, while Houston improved to 4-6. With general manager Chris Ballard already dismissed, Steichen could face similar scrutiny over the miserable Colts season. In the blowout loss, Steichen’s decision to attempt long field goals didn’t pay off. A 56-yard attempt was missed, while a 62-yard attempt was blocked. Houston built a 17-3 halftime lead and never relinquished control. Fans reacted to the latest Colts loss: “Colts need to fire him [Shane Steichen] tonight; complete dogwater game management,” one fan commented. “FIRE NOW and make him walk back to Indy,” one fan wrote. “Leave Shane Steichen in Houston,” one fan said. “FIRE SHANE STEICHEN ALREADY!” one fan commented. “Shane Steichen shouldn’t survive the mini bye,” one fan remarked. “Fire Shane Steichen,” one fan said. “Like right now. That was a national embarrassment,” one fan wrote. In the defeat against the Texans, the Colts offense struggled to generate momentum, finishing with only 167 total yards. Colts quarterback Daniel Jones went 12-of-27 for 144 yards and one interception. On the other hand, Texans quarterback CJ Stroud threw three touchdown passes against one interception while completing 21 of 27 passes. Shane Steichen’s Contract In Focus After Colts Dropped to 3-8 Despite falling to 3-8 this season, Colts head coach Shane Steichen still has two seasons remaining on his contract. In Feb. 2023, he signed a six-year deal. If the Colts decide to fire Steichen before the season ends, they will have to pay for the remaining part of his contract. On Oct. 19, when the Colts fired general manager Chris Ballard, Steichen survived the major shake-up as the front office has also traded away veteran players before the trade deadline. Previously, following the Colts’ defeat against the Jacksonville Jaguars, Steichen was asked about his future. “I’m focused on getting better,” Steichen said . “That’s what I’m focused on right now.” “We have a lot to fix,” Steichen added. “I’ve been saying that for a while. I understand that in this league, it’s fricking hard; you’ve got to find ways to win games. You’ve got to find ways to get out of holes. Right now, we’re not doing that good enough.” It’s unclear if Indianapolis is thinking about firing Steichen. After taking over the Colts in 2023, Steichen has led Indianapolis to a 28-34 record and has not led them into the playoffs so far. item.title: Reality Time for Wake Forest
item.description: | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Tony Siracusa, CFB Managing Editor Call it a “trap game.” Call it the next step to a conference championship opportunity. What it is is reality time for Wake Forest. The Demon Deacons travel to Atlanta to face Georgia Tech Saturday afternoon, with everything they have accomplished thus far on the line. Reality Time for Wake Forest Wake is the newly anointed number 11 team in the College Football Playoff rankings with a 9-1 overall record. That #11 spot makes them the last at-large team that would make the playoff this year. The #12 slot will go to a Group of Six school since none of them are ranked in the top 12 on their own. One slip over the last two weeks of the regular season and the blow to Wake’s season will be felt for years to come. Georgia Tech Will Not Go Quietly Even though Georgia Tech is in last place in the ACC with a 3-7 overall record and a 2-5 conference record, Wake head coach Jake Dickert is working to make sure no one takes the Yellowjackets for granted. They did, after all, just beat Clemson on the road last week by two touchdowns. “I’ve said this, and I really believe it. I think they are the most talented 3-7 team in the country,” Dickert said earlier this week. Of course, the two schools do not play every year, but Wake has lost the last five matchups between the two. The last time Wake beat GA Tech was 2006, 9-6. Clearing the Memories from Last Year Last year’s game in Winston-Salem still leaves a bad taste in the mouth of most Wake fans. After Wake running back Demond Claiborne scored on a 25-yard run to make it a 30-29 GA Tech lead in the second overtime, the Deacs went for two. Claiborne was hobbled. Quarterback Robby Ashford was hobbled. His pass into the end zone for the two points was intercepted, and the Deacs lost by one. Of course, there was also the missed offside call against GA Tech late in the game that shut down a Wake Forest drive. But Dickert and the Deacs have moved on from that, even if the fans never did. “This team, this moment, this timeframe, our energy and focus needs to be right here and right now.” He did have one piece of advice for the team this week that goes back to last year’s game. “Don’t leave it in anyone else’s hands. Go out and win the game. No excuses. Nothing else matters but what happens at the end of the day on the scoreboard.” The Yellowjackets This is obviously a different GA Tech in 2026 as it is. Quarterback Haynes King and his dual-threat abilities are gone. Alberto Mendoza , the younger brother of 2025 Heisman winner Fernando Mendoza is the starting quarterback. The transfer from Indiana threw for 138 yards in the win over Clemson last week. He has 11 touchdown passes and seven interceptions on the season. But Georgia Tech head coach Brent Key used two quarterbacks, with Gary Adamson also playing. He is not a threat in the passing game, but he ran 19 times for 87 yards and a touchdown. item.title: Houston leaves no doubt who should be college basketball’s new No. 1
item.description: Guess what, everybody? Kelvin Sampson and his Houston Cougars are back. Men's college basketball is about to have a new No. 1 team, and there's no doubt Houston belongs at the top after beating No. 9 Kansas 92-83 to win the Players Era 8 tournament, capping one of the most impressive runs of the young season. As the premier early season event , there's plenty of value in navigating the loaded field in Las Vegas and emerging victorious. Just ask Michigan last season. Houston didn't just win. The Cougars were dang near perfect. After taking down No. 1 Florida in the semifinal , the Cougars faced a Big 12 foe in Kansas that could very well meet them again in the conference championship game, possibly even the Final Four. Against the Jayhawks, though, it didn't look like a big-time battle. It looked like a coming-out party for Houston. The Cougars came right out and did what they do best: make life extremely annoying for opponents with relentless defense. Then came what quite possibly separates this team from the rest of the country: the complementary offense. Bill Self couldn't burn through his timeouts fast enough as Houston made life look way too easy around the basket, putting the Jayhawks in a blender for easy buckets Kansas couldn't seem to stop. It was a dominant first half. Houston led by as many as 24 points and entered halftime with 54, the most it has scored against a top-25 team in the past 30 years. Even when Kansas staged a furious comeback behind freshman star Tyran Stokes, cutting the deficit to four points with just under three minutes remaining, Houston didn't flinch. The Cougars scored the next eight points to put the dagger in. It took three tries, but Houston has finally emerged from Players Era as a champion after unsuccessful attempts in 2024 and 2025. New No. 1 team is clear There will be massive reshuffling in the USA TODAY Sports Coaches Poll after the top four teams all lost , and you don't have to look far to see who should be the new No. 1 on Monday, Nov. 23: the Cougars themselves. Not only did Houston win the Players Era 8, but it also had the toughest path of any team in the field as the only one to play two top-10 opponents. It beat both of them convincingly. The Cougars bullied the Gators in the rematch of the 2025 national championship game , unfazed by the pristine frontcourt of Thomas Haugh, Alex Condon and Rueben Chinyelu. Houston outmuscled Florida inside while guard Dedan Thomas Jr. lit up the Gators. If anything, the Cougars' toughest challenge came against Rutgers in the opening round, a game they still won by 12 points. Of the other top-10 teams still perfect, including Virginia, Texas and UCLA, none can compare to Houston's early résumé. The Cougars took down No. 1 and then one of the hottest offenses in the country, with both opponents ranked in the top four of KenPom . No one has wins as good as those. item.title: The Colts should “evaluate” Shane Steichen
item.description: HOUSTON, TEXAS - NOVEMBER 19: Head coach Shane Steichen of the Indianapolis Colts looks on against the Houston Texans during the fourth quarter of the game at Reliant Stadium on November 19, 2026 in Houston, Texas. (Photo by Kenneth Richmond/Getty Images) | Getty Images “We’ll evaluate everything.” Have you heard that before? It’s becoming a canned phrase and mantra for Indianapolis Colts head coach Shane Steichen. The most recent example comes after the Colts were ripped apart by the Houston Texans on Thursday Night Football. That’s a smart move, Shane. Maybe the Colts organization needs to do the same for you too. The Colts sit at 3-8 on the year, and Steichen’s overall record is 28-34. The man who was brought in due to his success with Jalen Hurts and the Philadelphia offense was unable to mold Anthony Richardson in the same fashion or create results. Zero postseason appearances and a 7-25 record when the opponent is over .500 make the case why he needs to be heavily scrutinized. It is wise to consider benching Daniel Jones. Does it get better? Maybe not. That’s on Chris Ballard and Steichen, however. Steichen had a choice between the two men at quarterback. Not that his options were necessarily glowing, but he picked Jones to be his guy. From the onset, it looked like a stroke of genius. Now, it looks disastrous. He can evaluate all he wants. The Colts organization should do the same. It isn’t just Steichen, but it starts there. Based on the last four years of data, the case can be made that a change in leadership is needed. Evaluating is normally a good thing. What can trip one up is the timing. Shane Steichen’s “evaluation” of Daniel Jones and the quarterback position might be too little, too late to save his job. Steichen’s time with the franchise might be drawing to a close, but the Colts organization will live on. Their time for evaluation is now. It starts with the head coach.

item.title: Barcelona icon Julio Salinas talks Lamine, Cubarsi, Balde, Kounde: ‘I’d sell him tomorrow’
item.description: Barcelona icon Julio Salinas talks Lamine, Cubarsi, Balde, Kounde: ‘I’d sell him tomorrow’ Barcelona’s performances this season have been largely consistent, and it was only a two-game streak in between when they lost against PSG and Real Madrid in back-to-back games. They have been in red-hot form, scoring goals for fun and dominating games with relative ease. Yet, there always remains an element of concern and criticism from fans. They are set to return to action this weekend against Villarreal, and will do so hoping to retain the momentum firmly on their side. After all, they entered the international break after two massive wins over Aston Villa and Atletico Madrid – something that gave them a feeling of confidence after their week of disaster. Salinas backs Barcelona’s defence Former Barcelona and Spain attacker Julio Salinas spoke to the media in a recent interview where he dealt with several topics related to the club including their performances and criticism received this season. Notably, he dived into depth about Barcelona’s defensive situation and the discourse over the club needing a new world-class defender to stay on the same page as Europe’s elite. His view, however, was the opposite. “I’ll sign a centre-back tomorrow, but we have a defence that allows us to compete for everything,” he said. Salinas deemed Kounde saleable. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) The former player then called Inigo Martinez’s departure a ‘mistake’ from Barcelona’s end, as has been pointed out many times. “Letting Inigo Martinez leave was a mistake. I would have convinced him to stay by extending his contract for two more years.” “Cubarsi is one of the best defenders in the world, and Eric Garcia is a great player,” he added, giving his verdict on the centre-backs. Finally, the Basque legend spoke out on Barcelona’s full-backs and what he made of each player. “I’d sell Kounde tomorrow, because you have Xavi Espart.” “As for Balde, I think he’s a great player. I really like him,” he added. On the UCL aspirations Salinas then spoke on Barcelona’s UEFA Champions League aspirations and whether he saw the team as capable of winning the accolade under Hansi Flick. “Barcelona have a great squad and everything they need to compete for the Champions League. They have an amazing team.” “There are times when you lose focus and tell yourself that a draw isn’t a bad result,” he added. Emphasising the importance of handling different game situations well, especially when already in a lead, he said, “You shouldn’t give up on trying to win, but there’s no need to push all your players forward and then concede a goal.” On Lamine Yamal’s situation with Spain Lamine Yamal missed Spain’s first game in the recent international break due to physical discomfort, and Luis de La Fuente was generous enough to hand the player rest to get back to his best. item.title: MLB, college sports, and the sports propaganda moment
item.description: MILWAUKEE, WISCONSIN - OCTOBER 23: MLB Commissioner Rob Manfred speaks with the media prior to game one of the 2026 World Series between the Tampa Bay Rays and the Milwaukee Brewers at American Family Field on October 23, 2026 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. (Photo by John Fisher/Getty Images) | Getty Images When we’re in school, we hear a lot about propaganda. American history textbooks show us political cartoons from the late 19th and early 20th century about the abolition of slavery, the rise of industrial robber-barons, and the progressive movement. European art historians discuss how Louis XIV used paintings and sculptures to present himself as the “Sun King” as he strengthened the power of the French crown over the First and Second Estates. In my own Roman history classes, I spend multiple weeks demonstrating how the emperors employed literature, history, sculpture, and construction projects to assert the supremacy of both Rome and the imperial household. Whether in middle school, high school, or college, students regularly grapple with propaganda in their history classes, learning how people with access to communicative resources have been able to present their own version of reality to sway public opinion in their favor. Once we’re out of school, though, propaganda falls by the wayside, and ceases to be a concern. It exists, in the public consciousness at least, not as a part of our lives, but as a historical oddity, the behavior of a bygone era — or, when it’s acknowledged in the modern world, as something that happens in the nebulous “over there,” not “here.” And yet, what else can we call the flood of political advertisements in every commercial break that made the World Series borderline unwatchable if not propaganda? After all, are they not trying to sell their version of reality, as opposed to that of their opponents, in an effort to sway voters? Propaganda is most often understood in terms of politics, but it doesn’t have to be. And right now, we’re living in what I call a sports propaganda moment, as two major entities — the NCAA and Major League Baseball — have gone on the figurative warpath, spending millions of dollars in advertising not to get people to watch their product, but to generate outrage from fans on their own behalf against that of their players. Whether you’re a fan of a power conference school who competes for the national championship every year or a small liberal arts college who celebrates when their team gets blown out during the March Madness tournament because that meant they made it in the first place, you’ve almost certainly been exposed to commercials sponsored by the Saving College Sports organization in support of the Protect College Sports Act. item.title: Stewart Cink admits if players actually want Tiger Woods to compete on PGA Tour Champions in 2027
item.description: Photo by Rich Storry/TGL/TGL Golf via Getty Images Tiger Woods will return to action in just two weeks’ time at the Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas. Woods has not played a competitive tournament since The Open Championship in July 2024, and he has experienced all sorts of problems away from the golf course since then. The 15-time major champion has been involved in two serious car accidents and has been in and out of rehab in order to get a handle on his addiction to painkillers. However, Tiger Woods is nothing if he is not a fighter, and there is no way that he will bow out of the game without making one final push to try and win what would be a record-setting 83rd PGA Tour title. Woods is expected to play some big events in 2027, including The Genesis Invitational, The Masters and The Open Championship. However, he may well be looking to play certain PGA Tour Champions events as well, in order to beef out his schedule and to get some competitive reps under his belt ahead of the majors. Stewart Cink on Tiger Woods potentially competing on PGA Tour Champions Cink has spoken to SiriusXM PGA TOUR Radio about Tiger Woods potentially playing on PGA Tour Champions in 2027. The 2009 Open champion responded when asked whether Woods would actually be welcome on the senior tour. “ We would love for Tiger to come play, and he’s one of the guys I have in mind when I constantly say, like, guys are gonna like it out there, “ Cink explained. “ I just think Tiger is a golfer at heart. He wants to compete, but I don’t know any of his plans. I hope he does. It would be great for the tour and I think it would be good for him too. “ He would really love it, to see some new venues and it’s just, it’s competitive golf. He’s going to get in contention and have a chance to win a whole lot of tournaments. Not that that’s anything new to him, but he still thrives on it. I think it’s something that never gets old for anybody. “ So I wish him the best. It’s going to be great to see him back playing. “ It would be great to see Tiger Woods play on PGA Tour Champions in 2027. He would surely love to compete against many of his old rivals, including the likes of Ernie Els, Vijay Singh, Retief Goosen and Padraig Harrington. It would also be slightly easier on his body, with 54-hole tournaments and the use of golf carts available as well. Woods needs to ease back into action over the next few months, and playing one or two PGA Tour Champions events will be the best way for him to do just that.

item.title: Red Wings’ Seider Biggest Loser in Edvinsson Negotiations
item.description: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect As the Red Wings and Simon Edvinsson continue their contract standoff off the ice, Detroit finds itself with a losing record and a defense that more often than not looks like it could really use the second half of their usual first pairing. The Red Wings have done a lot in the last year to reshape their blueline and have two true rookies playing big minutes on a nightly basis in Anton Johansson and William Wallinder right now. However, the team has lost six of their last seven games and the cracks are not only starting to show, they’re becoming larger fractures. Burning fuel The Red Wings have largely decided to rely on Moritz Seider to carry the team’s defense, with the big blueliner averaging two shifts more than his teammates and just under 26 minutes per game. After a career year last year with Edvinsson opposite him, Seider is sitting at a -15 rating this year and has just one goal through the first 22 games of the Red Wings season. Seider is tied for second on the team with 12 assists. However, after finishing last year 5th in Norris Trophy voting, this year has seen Seider’s job get that much harder without a capable no. 2 defenseman on his left side. A negative +/- rating doesn’t mean much in the grand scheme of things, and when actually watching Seider, there’s no doubt that he’s the best defenseman on this team, if not in the NHL. However, the eye test (especially from a view in the rafters)tells you a lot more about how a defenseman is feeling about himself. This season certainly seems.. frustrating for Seider so far. The German defenseman’s taken the third most penalty minutes on the team, and projects to have the most in his career by the end of the season. The majority have come over the course of the last 18 days. One incident in Colorado accounts for half the total, with Seider called for two separate roughing penalties, one paired with a five minute trip to the penalty box for fighting Avalanche captain Gabe Landeskog. Why are we here? Detroit has tried, unsuccessfully, to find someone to play the left side to help for the year, but the result so far has mostly been Seider covering for the other half of his pairing. Ben Chiarot is on the back half of his career, and to let you in on a little secret, he is not paid for his defensive contributions. Chiarot makes his money because he’ll pull an opponents glove off when the ref isn’t looking and then block a shot in the other zone while the other guy is still picking his equipment off the ice. As a player who has been around since the Atlanta Thrashers were still a franchise, Chiarot’s business is making life difficult for opposing offenses. That doesn’t exactly mean he has to play good defense to be good at his job. Detroit have also tried their two aforementioned rookies on the top pairing, to varying levels of success. item.title: Pep Guardiola Reunites With Fan-Favourite Manchester City Alumnus in Brazil
item.description: Pep Guardiola Reunites With Fan-Favourite Manchester City Alumnus in Brazil Some months on from his emotional departure from the Etihad Stadium earlier this year, Pep Guardiola has been making the most of a rare spell away from the dugout. He has not been short of suitors, mind, having recently been linked with the vacant United States job, though he is expected to reject the approach and prolong his break from management. In the meantime, he has been putting the downtime to good use, and one snapshot from his travels is sure to bring a smile to the faces of supporters back in Manchester. Guardiola has been pictured reuniting with an old friend from his trophy-laden years at the club, a familiar face who still holds fan-favourite status in the blue half of the city. A warm reunion in Brazil The man in question is Fernandinho, the much-loved former Manchester City midfielder, who shared a photograph of the pair together. Posting on Instagram , the Brazilian, smartly dressed and all smiles in an office, captioned the image simply: “So happy to have you here in Brazil, Pep.” Guardiola is in Brazil to watch City Football Group side Bahia , making the trip alongside Manchester City chief executive Ferran Soriano. The journey is part of the ambassadorial and technical advisory role Pep took up within City Football Group after bringing the curtain down on his spell in Manchester. Seeing the two together will stir fond memories for City supporters; Fernandinho was one of the few players Guardiola inherited in 2016 whom he trusted from the very outset. While the new manager set about reshaping the squad, the Brazilian quickly made himself indispensable, and he would remain a key figure for more than half a decade. Signed from Shakhtar Donetsk in 2013 at the age of 28, Fernandinho became the defensive anchor around which Guardiola built his finest sides. He was the shield in front of the back four during the record-breaking 2017/18 campaign, when City amassed 100 points with Kevin De Bruyne and David Silva pulling the strings ahead of him. He was arguably even better the following season, a pillar of the side that edged out Liverpool to the title by a single point, and earned a place in the PFA Team of the Year. When David Silva departed in 2020, it was Fernandinho who inherited the captain’s armband, leading the club with the same authority he had long shown on the pitch. By the time he left the Etihad in 2022 to return home with Athletico Paranaense, Fernandinho had collected five Premier League titles and cemented his standing as one of the most dependable servants of the Guardiola era. Now retired from playing, his bond with his former manager clearly endures, and it would be wise not to bet against the pair working together again some day down the line.

item.title: Key Matchup: Kentucky’s Malachi Moreno will look to challenge Indiana’s rebuilt frontcourt
item.description: CHICAGO, ILLINOIS - NOVEMBER 10: Malachi Moreno #24 of the Kentucky Wildcats shoots over Taylen Kinney #0 of the Kansas Jayhawks during the second half in the 2026 State Farm Champions Classic at United Center on November 10, 2026 in Chicago, Illinois. (Photo by Michael Reaves/Getty Images) | Getty Images Indiana men’s basketball is set to face Kentucky on Friday night at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana. We’ll be working to highlight a key opposing matchup in each of the Hoosiers’ games moving forward and this one was a no brainer. If Moreno’s name sounds familiar it’s either because you pay a lot of attention to relatively local high school ball or Indiana’s recruiting. Moreno was a big target for Mike Woodson before the latter parted ways with the program and ended up committing to Mark Pope and in-state Kentucky pretty quickly. Here’s what to know about Moreno ahead of this season’s matchup: Download the SB Nation app on iOS or Android for coverage of the Hoosiers and all your favorite teams! Key Matchup: C Malachi Moreno Class: Sophomore Avg: 14.2 points, 9 rebounds, 3.2 assists per game Shooting: 66.7% from the field, 65.2% from the free throw line Moreno played decent minutes for last year’s group but has taken the sophomore leap and then some in year two with mostly increased averages and efficiency across the board. He joined Kentucky as a member of the 2025 signing class, rating as a 4-star by 247Sports and a 5-star by the 247Sports composite rating, ranking in as the 2nd highest-rated center and 25th highest-rated prospect overall in his class. Moreno has Kentucky’s highest usage rate at 27% on the season with only freshman point guard Mason Williams outpacing his assist rate of 21.3%. He’s got a team-leading effective field goal percentage of 66.7% and a block rate of 8.7%. He’s the anchor on both ends of the floor. So how can Indiana play him? Samet Yigitoglu will probably draw the assignment and should, Indiana has to avoid letting smaller guys get switched onto Moreno so he can go to work down low and, worse, draw fouls. Moreno doesn’t convert well from the free throw line, hitting on 65.2% there, but Indiana would do well to avoid foul trouble in the backcourt and easy looks. Moreno isn’t a factor from the 3-point line, only having taken a handful during his time in college, so he won’t be able to draw the Hoosier bigs out through floor spacing. He is, however, a strong passer to the point of creating his own non-shooting gravity, so you’d rather give him some pressure than let him survey the court. He has a really strong offensive rebounding rate of 17.6%, so Indiana will need to be physical with him early to keep him from generating extra chances on the glass. Indiana probably won’t neutralize Moreno, he’s gonna be able to get some good looks down low while finding the open man as a passer. item.title: UK government can't keep its encryption-busting order to Apple a secret, tribunal rules
item.description: The Investigatory Powers Tribunal (IPT) has confirmed that the UK government served Apple with a secret Technical Capability Notice (TCN), rejecting the Home Office's argument that acknowledging its existence would damage national security. The order has been widely reported as demanding access to end-to-end encrypted iCloud data. The three judges pointed to extensive public reporting, statements by US officials, and media briefings they concluded had been authorized by the UK government. The Home Office had previously adopted its "neither confirm nor deny" (NCND) policy, as is standard when discussing national security matters. The story broke in February 2025, when The Washington Post reported that the Home Office had demanded an iCloud backdoor the previous month. A TCN is a notice issued under the Investigatory Powers Act 2016, which compels recipients, such as tech companies, to implement technical changes that facilitate the UK government's legal surveillance powers. For Apple, a company that has long made privacy central to its marketing, and famously rejected an FBI order to break open an iPhone to assist a terror probe, being served the TCN meant it either had to somehow defy a legal order issued by the UK, or undermine the encryption technology that customers expected. While it remained officially unconfirmed at the time, Apple's decision to revoke Advanced Data Protection (ADP) for UK users in February 2025 was widely interpreted as indirect confirmation of the demand. At the same time, US policymakers urged then-director of national intelligence Tulsi Gabbard to oppose the UK's demands under the assumption that they also sought to backdoor Apple's data in a way that would affect US citizens. In August 2025, Gabbard announced that the UK had agreed to drop its demand for access to Americans' encrypted data. ADP is still available to users in the US. Apple's ADP extends end-to-end encryption to additional categories of iCloud data, including backups, photos, and notes. Only trusted devices retain access to the relevant encryption keys, leaving Apple unable to decrypt that protected content for investigators. Without ADP, those additional categories revert to standard protection: the data remains encrypted, but Apple holds the keys and can disclose content in response to valid legal demands. Some categories remain end-to-end encrypted regardless. Apple has an explainer on what data types remain end-to-end encrypted, even without ADP enabled, and those that are not. What the judgment does not confirm While the IPT's judgment confirms that the Home Office served Apple with a TCN, judges have yet to decide whether key details about the case can be made public. "Although there has been extensive media coverage and public statements about the existence of a technical capability notice, there has been no publication of its precise content," the judgment stated. "All parties recognize that there may be matters of detail that must be kept secret

The Trump administration imposed a sweeping ban on foreign-made consumer routers in March 2026, and TP-Link hasn't been able to obtain an exemption. The rules prevent the import or sale of all new router models that are manufactured, assembled, designed, or developed outside the US. The Trump administration has control over which router makers receive special permission to import and sell new products through a waiver-review process involving the Federal Communications Commission, the Department of Defense, and the Department of Homeland Security. While some of its competitors have obtained exemptions to the ban, TP-Link appears to be having a hard time making its case to government officials.
